subject: Consent matrix and ink-windowing for Atlas MAP
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@atlaslabs.com>; procurement@atlaslabs.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP + consent matrix for Atlas pilot (first pass)

Hi Elena / Atlas procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week — attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan and the consent matrix we discussed. High-level asks in this MAP:
- Security evidence delivery (SOC2 + data handling appendix) by Tue 5/25
- Pilot evaluation window: 6/1–6/21 (2-week run + 1 week wrap-up)
- Exec approval and signature window: target week of 6/28–7/2 (we've left a 5-day signer window to accommodate legal)

Two immediate items I want to confirm with you:
1) Is the proposed exec-signature week OK for Atlas (we can shift earlier if you need)?
2) Who is the authorized signer we should prepare the DocuSign for (we'll pre-fill per your instruction)?

Attachments: Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes calendar milestones and owner matrix; SOW_Atlas_v3.docx (working draft).

Next steps: if the timeline looks reasonable, we'll lock the MAP and push a DocuSign SOW with the exec signature block pre-populated.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference platform

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@atlaslabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@atlaslabs.com; Tom Heller <tom.heller@atlaslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + consent matrix for Atlas pilot (first pass)

Karthik — thanks for sending. I shared the MAP with Procurement and Legal this morning. A couple quick notes: 

- Procurement asks that the signature window be a firm 3-business-day window rather than a rolling 5-day stretch (they want to coordinate courier/ESIGN timing). Can you accommodate a 6/29–7/1 window?
- Legal flagged a single clause in SOW_Atlas_v3.docx (Section 4.2) around data residency; they requested we mark 'data residency: US-only' in the consent matrix if we expect a start date prior to their final review.

Authorized signer is likely our CFO, Tom Heller (cc'd). He asked for a short list of exec-level approvers from your side so he knows who will countersign on Redwood's side if needed.

Also — procurement asked for an itemized list of the deliverables and their dates as a CSV so they can import into their procurement system. Exec_Signature_List.csv would be ideal.

Elena
VP, Platform Partnerships — Atlas Labs

Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@atlaslabs.com>, procurement@atlaslabs.com, Tom Heller <tom.heller@atlaslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: finalize consent matrix + signer roster (recap for Atlas thread)

Karthik / Naomi — quick internal note before I reply to Atlas: 

1) Procurement preference: 6/29–7/1 strict 3-business-day signature window. We can accommodate that, but we need exec-level availability from our CEO or CRO for quick countersign if Tom signs first. Naomi — can you confirm who's available that week?
2) Legal asked to lock data residency to US-only if start date is before 7/6. We should accept that for the pilot and note the option to expand region later.
3) I'll produce Exec_Signature_List.csv (3 rows: Tom Heller (Atlas CFO), Redwood CRO — Heidi Park, Redwood CEO — Aaron Stern) and the itemized deliverables CSV for procurement import.

Draft reply to Atlas (short): agree to 6/29–7/1 signature window; confirm US-only residency for pilot; provide signer CSV and updated MAP with residency column. Ask Atlas to confirm Tom as authorized signer and to confirm courier/e-sign preference (DocuSign ok).

I will send the reply and the two CSV attachments in ~30 minutes unless you object.

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Deal Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@atlaslabs.com>, procurement@atlaslabs.com, Tom Heller <tom.heller@atlaslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + consent matrix for Atlas pilot (first pass)

Marissa / Karthik / Atlas team —

Confirmed: Redwood can accept a firm 3-business-day signature window of 2027-06-29 to 2027-07-01. Naomi (me) will be primary countersigner if Tom executes on 6/29; Heidi Park (CRO) will be backup if I am out. We will also lock the data residency setting to US-only for the pilot period and call out the change in the MAP's consent matrix (I will update Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx and re-attach).

Marissa: please proceed with sending Exec_Signature_List.csv and the itemized deliverables CSV to procurement@atlaslabs.com and cc me. Once Tom confirms the signer name, Karthik — please generate the DocuSign envelope and pre-fill Tom's name and email. Use envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/0A12-ATLAS-SOW and set reminder on day 2.

Start date: contingent on signed SOW; if signatures are complete by 2027-07-01 we plan to go-live onboarding week of 2027-07-05 (kickoff call scheduled tentatively for 7/6). Please confirm availability for a 60-min kickoff on Tues 7/6 afternoon PT.

Attachments: Exec_Signature_List.csv (prepared), Atlas_MAP_v1_updated.xlsx (updated consent column).

Naomi Feldman
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
